bin_seed.help_text: Set a fixed seed for metaBAT1/2 and CONCOCT.

concoct_min_contig.help_text: Minimum threshold for contig size (bp). The lowest accepted value is 500.

maxbin2_min_contig.help_text: Minimum threshold for contig size (kb). The lowest accepted value is 500.

metabat_min_contig.help_text: Minimum threshold for contig size (kb). The lowest accepted value is 1500.

maxbin_markers.help_text: Marker set to choose from 107 marker genes present in >95% of bacteria, or 40 marker gene sets that are universal among bacteria and archaea.

metabat1.help_text: Run metaBAT1 binning instead of default metaBAT2.

semibin2_environment.help_text: Pretrained habitat model for SemiBin2's single_easy_bin --environment (skips self-supervised training).

metacat_wheel_url.help_text: Path (or URL) to the MetaCAT pip wheel to install at runtime (no bioconda/biocontainers package exists yet). Defaults to a pre-downloaded local copy so the task doesn't depend on outbound network access.
